name: thisdid
description: ThisDID.com — DIF Universal W3C DID Resolver.

scripts.vendor:list: echo near-did-resolver webvh-did-resolver plc-did-resolver jwk-did-resolver cheqd-did-resolver dns-did-resolver ens-did-resolver cid-did-resolver ion-did-resolver sol-did-resolver iden3-did-resolver hedera-did-resolver xrpl-did-resolver iota-did-resolver empe-did-resolver dht-did-resolver tz-did-resolver oyd-did-resolver web-did-resolver peer-did-resolver ethr-did-resolver key-did-resolver pkh-did-resolver
scripts.forks:list: echo did-peer web-did-resolver peer-did-resolver didwebvh-ts ethr-did-resolver js-did
scripts.install:forks: (cd vendor/forks/did-peer && npm ci --ignore-scripts) && (cd vendor/forks/peer-did-resolver && yarn install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --non-interactive) && for d in web-did-resolver didwebvh-ts ethr-did-resolver js-did; do (cd vendor/forks/$d && [ -f package.json ] || { echo "vendor/forks/$d has no package.json — is the submodule initialized?"; exit 1; } && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --config.manage-package-manager-versions=false) || exit 1; done && (cd vendor/forks/atproto && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod --filter '@atproto/identity...' --config.include-workspace-root=false --config.manage-package-manager-versions=false)
scripts.build:forks: (cd vendor/forks/did-peer && npm run build) && (cd vendor/forks/peer-did-resolver && yarn run build) && for d in web-did-resolver didwebvh-ts; do (cd vendor/forks/$d && pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error run build) || exit 1; done && (cd vendor/forks/ethr-did-resolver && pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error --filter ethr-did-resolver run build) && (cd vendor/forks/js-did && pnpm -r --config.verify-deps-before-run=error --config.manage-package-manager-versions=false run build) && tsc --build vendor/forks/atproto/packages/identity/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:forks: (cd vendor/forks/did-peer && npm test -- --run) && (cd vendor/forks/peer-did-resolver && yarn test) && for d in web-did-resolver didwebvh-ts; do (cd vendor/forks/$d && pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error test) || exit 1; done && (cd vendor/forks/ethr-did-resolver/packages/ethr-did-resolver && HARDHAT_CONFIG=hardhat.config.mts pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error exec vitest run --exclude src/__tests__/networks.integration.test.ts) && (cd vendor/forks/js-did && pnpm -r --config.verify-deps-before-run=error --config.manage-package-manager-versions=false run test)
scripts.install:vendor: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm run install:forks && for d in did-resolver $(npm run -s vendor:list); do (cd vendor/$d && [ -f package.json ] || { echo "vendor/$d has no package.json — is the submodule initialized?"; exit 1; } && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:vendor: npm run build:forks && for d in did-resolver $(npm run -s vendor:list); do (cd vendor/$d && pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && concurrently -k -n drivers,worker,web -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm:dev:drivers" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
